title: Robust Ion-Photon Entanglement via Polarization-to-Time-Bin Conversion
summary: Time-bin photonic qubits are well-suited for quantum network applications due to their robustness to polarization instability in fiber links and potential for heterogeneous networks. In this work, we implement the first entanglement-preserving polarization-to-time-bin conversion of a photon qubit in an entangled state with a matter qubit, together with the independent work of Haen \textit{et al.} \cite{haen2026telecom}.
